text: This is one fictional Zambia tender for ten vaccine refrigerators. Two timely bids, prices in kwacha, and criteria issued before evaluation. Technical capability carries sixty percent; delivery carries forty. The demonstration contains no real supplier's tax record. The source documents and starting state are included so a reviewer can reproduce the result.
